independent_source_reviews.change: scalar rigid-transform placement and cached identity
independent_source_reviews.reviewer: independent solid_benchmark agent, plus root arithmetic review
conclusions: Each multiplication, TwoSum operation, outward-rounding call, product/residual accumulation and final L1 error bound retains its original evaluation order.

The final CadRigidTransform class owns an unmodifiable rotation matrix and a concrete immutable translation snapshot, so cached identity cannot become stale. Source coordinates remain captured once and negative-zero handling is unchanged.

The review preserves the existing precision policy; it establishes neither a new accuracy guarantee nor isolated performance attribution. No test or timing reruns were performed for this independent review.

independent_source_reviews.change: bounded degree-two mesh vertex-link cycle walk
conclusions: The unchanged minimum-size and degree-two checks apply to a private symmetric simple link graph. Each connected component is therefore a cycle.

The bounded walk accepts only when it returns to the start after visiting exactly link.length vertices. It terminates after at most link.length minus one iterations and rejects disconnected cycles, including unequal pinched fans.

Issue insertion order and outer vertex order remain unchanged. Regressions cover multiple valences, permutations, cyclic triangle rotations, relabeling and unequal pinched shells with independent volume expectations.
No blocker found. The independent review ran no tests or timings; final-source gates separately validate the integrated result.

independent_source_reviews.change: empty argument placeholders and local scratch/typed-array bindings
independent_source_reviews.status: correctness review accepted; both source changes rejected after performance screening and reverted
conclusions: Argument list ownership remains independent per layout and workspace; all placeholder slots are populated before callbacks.
The evaluate-only scratch binding preserves first scratch access after the existing cancellation check; arithmetic, polling, preference handling and diagnostic behavior remain unchanged.
The final solver blob is byte-identical to merged main. The callback/list isolation regression remains in final tests. No retained numerical speedup is claimed.
